main_topics.reason: User came because infliximab stopped working and Humira was presented as the only option; most turns cover alternatives and questions to ask.
User opens furious at being brushed off and says everyone treats their questions as awkward; they want to be part of the decision.
User is furious at the start and later says they feel they have a handle on things instead of just being angry.
Raised by the bot, but user engaged and took it up as a concrete point to push back with.
User asked directly about a second opinion and worried it would look like going behind the consultant's back, over a few turns.
User accepted a question list and plans to take it to the appointment.
Stated as background in the opening message: infliximab stopped working after four years.

output.summary: User on infliximab for four years, which stopped working, was angry that their consultant presented a switch to Humira as decided and brushed off questions about alternatives. The bot validated their frustration, explained other biologic classes, raised drug-level and antibody testing, drafted questions for the appointment, and answered a question about second opinions on the NHS. User ended saying they have a plan, not just a grievance, and will book the appointment and take their list.
